title: Do-not-contact list (R13)
description: File: invitations/do-not-contact.yaml (docs/growth.md). The people who refused, who did not answer the reminder, or who asked for their file to be withdrawn: only the fingerprints of their identifiers (SHA-256, in hexadecimal, of the canonical key: identifier, channel, cited profiles), never a name in plain text. Append-only, by the council; an entry is never removed (a refusal is final). Limit: the fingerprint of a public login can be found by trying logins; it prevents reading in passing, not a determined search.
